title: override beats the command line
objective: Force one variable to keep the Makefile's own value no matter what the command line says, while the variable next to it is still replaceable.
hint: Put override in front of the assignment. Assignments without it keep losing to the command line, which is exactly what the second variable should do.

steps.description: without extra arguments both assignments are in charge
steps.stdout:
echo mode is release
mode is release
echo plain is from the Makefile
plain is from the Makefile

steps.description: override held its ground, the plain assignment did not
steps.stdout:
echo mode is release
mode is release
echo plain is from the command line
plain is from the command line
